description: This source file defines the implementation of the CreateCVDAction for orchestrating Google Android Virtual Device (CVD) creation, including request validation, launching CVDs from Android CI build sources, handling build artifacts, and managing the CVD creation process via a CLI interface.

classes.name: BuildAPICredentials
classes.description: Holds credentials for API access, including OAuth tokens and GCP project ID.

classes.name: CreateCVDActionOpts
classes.description: Options for constructing a CreateCVDAction, including request parameters and dependencies.

classes.name: CreateCVDAction
classes.description: Encapsulates the logic to create and launch a CVD based on provided parameters and environment.

methods.name: NewCreateCVDAction
methods.description: Constructs a new CreateCVDAction instance from given options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the CVD creation process asynchronously, validating request and environment before launching CVD.

methods.name: launchCVD
methods.description: Handles the CVD launch operation, processing environment config if provided.

methods.name: launchWithCanonicalConfig
methods.description: Prepares and loads the CVD environment config from a request, handling credentials and config files.

methods.name: launchCVDResult
methods.description: Generates the CVD group based on the request, supporting Android CI build sources.

methods.name: launchFromAndroidCI
methods.description: Launches a CVD from Android CI build sources, managing artifacts and starting the CVD process.

methods.name: newInstanceNumbers
methods.description: Generates a sequence of unique instance numbers for CVD instances.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates the create CVD request for necessary fields and configurations.

methods.name: createTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with specified data and permissions, used for config serialization.
